effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] If you have a blue Tamer, by trashing the top 3 cards of your deck, this Digimon gets +2000 DP for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] By returning 3 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
